# Task List: Destructive styling & Trash a11y follow-ups (FU-5, FU-7, FU-9)

Source spec: `specs/features/destructive-styling-a11y.md` (Gate 3 approved
2026-09-15; OQ-2 amended at Gate 4, 2026-09-15, switching the approved axe
runner from `vitest-axe` to direct `axe-core@4.11.4`). All 5 open questions
(OQ-1 through OQ-5) are resolved on the source spec by owner decision; this
task list does not reopen or re-answer any of them.

**Consumer enumeration (FR-7, committed artifact):** generated by grepping the
repo at task-list authoring time (excluding `frontend/.next/standalone`,
which is build output, not source) and confirmed to match the spec's
recorded counts exactly:

- `frontend/components/**` — 72 files use `text-gw-secondary`/
  `text-gw-secondary-light` (310 total occurrences across components, app,
  and stories combined).
- `frontend/stories/**` — 17 files.
- `frontend/app/**` — 4 files: `frontend/app/(app)/page.tsx`,
  `frontend/app/login/page.tsx`, `frontend/app/reset-password/page.tsx`,
  `frontend/app/verify-email/page.tsx`.
- `variant="destructive"` consumers (excluding build output): `frontend/
  components/WorkArea/Views/TrashView/TrashView.tsx`, `frontend/components/
  common/ConfirmDialog.tsx`, `frontend/stories/Foundations/Button.stories.tsx`,
  `frontend/stories/Foundations/Dialog.stories.tsx`.

The full per-file lists live at `specs/features/destructive-styling-a11y/
consumer-list-components.txt`, `consumer-list-stories.txt`, and
`consumer-list-app.txt` (written by Task 3, which performs the actual sync —
these are the exact file sets Task 3's "no other visual change" claim is
checked against, and what Task 4's re-verification sweep iterates over). No
task other than Task 3 needs to re-run this grep; Task 4 reads the recorded
lists.

**Placement decision:** no new model, transport, or slice code is needed —
this feature is a CSS token change, one component's variant alias, one test
rewrite, one Storybook parameter addition, and two doc edits. There is no
`frontend/src/lib/models/` or `frontend/src/store/` work.

**Shared-file caution (schedule sequentially, not concurrently):** the
following files are touched by more than one task below and must not be

### Task 1: Measure `vitest-axe` compatibility via dry-run lockfile resolution (FR-9)

**What:** Per resolved OQ-2, measures the exact lockfile change a `vitest-axe`
install would produce, without installing anything into the real worktree,
and records the result for owner approval. Copies `frontend/package.json`,
the repo-root `package.json`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, and `pnpm-lock.yaml`
into a scratch directory outside the worktree (`$TMPDIR` or the session
scratchpad — never a path under `/Users/jedaisaboteur/Repositories/getwrite`),
then runs `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend add -D vitest-axe@<exact>
--lockfile-only --ignore-scripts` there against the latest version resolvable
at measurement time. Records: every lockfile package entry added or changed,
with exact versions; whether `axe-core@4.11.4` (already resolved in the
repo's real `pnpm-lock.yaml` as a transitive of `@storybook/addon-a11y`) is
reused by `vitest-axe`'s own resolution or whether a second copy is added;
`vitest-axe`'s declared peer-dependency range for `vitest` and whether
`vitest@4.1.6` (the repo's exact pinned version) satisfies it; whether it
declares any `jsdom` peer/dependency and whether `jsdom@^28.1.0` (the repo's
version) satisfies it; the package's licence (from its `package.json` in the
scratch `node_modules` or the registry metadata); and a
`docs/standards/package-selection.md`-format justification (purpose,
existing-dependency check, size/maintenance signal). **This task performs no
real install and touches no file under the repo.** It stops here and reports
the exact measured set to the lead for owner approval — Task 2 does not run
until that approval is recorded as an edit to this task list (see Task 2's
Depends-on). If `vitest-axe` proves incompatible with `vitest@4.1.6` or
`jsdom@^28.1.0` during the dry run (a peer range that excludes the pinned
version, or the dry run itself failing), this task records that evidence
instead and performs the same dry-run measurement for a direct `axe-core`
dependency plus a small hand-rolled `vitest`/jsdom integration helper as the
owner-approved fallback, at the same approval gate.
**Files:** none in the repo. Scratch-directory copies only (outside the
worktree); a written record of the measurement is added as this task's own
**Notes** field below once run.
**Done when:**
1. The scratch-directory dry run has been executed and its `pnpm-lock.yaml`
   diff captured in full.
2. This task's Notes field (below) records every added/changed lockfile
   entry with exact version, the `axe-core` reuse-or-duplicate finding, the
   `vitest`/`jsdom` peer-compatibility finding, the licence, and the
   package-selection justification (or, on incompatibility, the same for the
   `axe-core`-direct fallback).
3. The task list (this file) is updated with the lead/owner's explicit
   approval of the exact measured set before Task 2 begins — recorded as an
   edit to Task 2's own Notes field naming the approved set verbatim.
4. `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend lint` passes with 0 errors and
   `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend typecheck` passes, run from the main
   worktree (unaffected by this task, since no repo file changes — confirms
   no drift before the next task begins).
**Depends on:** none
**Estimate:** 2
**Notes:** **Measured by the lead at Gate 4 (2026-09-15).** Each option was
dry-run in a scratch copy of the workspace manifests and `pnpm-lock.yaml`
with `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend add -D <spec> --lockfile-only
--ignore-scripts`, pnpm 10.28.0.
- `vitest-axe@0.1.0` (npm `latest`, released 2022-10-21, MIT, peer `vitest
  >=0.16.0`) adds `vitest-axe@0.1.0` and `lodash-es@4.18.1` (MIT). Reuses
  `axe-core@4.11.4`, `aria-query@5.3.2`, `chalk@5.6.2`,
  `dom-accessibility-api@0.5.16`, and `redent@3.0.0`.
- `vitest-axe@1.0.0-pre.5` (npm `pre`, released 2025-01-22, MIT, peer
  `vitest >=1`) adds `vitest-axe@1.0.0-pre.5` and `lodash-es@4.18.1`. Reuses
  `@vitest/pretty-format@3.2.4`, `axe-core@4.11.4`, and `chalk@5.6.2`.
- `axe-core@4.11.4` (MPL-2.0; npm latest is 4.13.0) adds **no new package
  entries** — only the direct devDependency importer entry for an
  already-resolved package.
- All three runs also rewrote only the peer suffixes of the existing
  `eslint-import-resolver-typescript@3.10.1`, `eslint-module-utils@2.12.1`,
  and `eslint-plugin-import@2.32.0` entries, with no version changes (the
  same normalisation the DOCX importer's mammoth dry run showed). No new

- `docs/standards/package-selection.md` §1 ("use well-established, actively

This is the analogue of the DOCX importer's Task 1

### Task 2: Install the approved `axe-core@4.11.4` dependency (FR-9)

**What:** Adds the exact dependency Task 1 measured and the owner approved —
`axe-core@4.11.4` as a `devDependency` of `frontend/package.json` — and runs
a real install to update `pnpm-lock.yaml`: `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend
add -D axe-core@4.11.4` (or an equivalent frozen-compatible command). **Only
this task may write `frontend/package.json` or `pnpm-lock.yaml`; no other
task in this feature runs any package-manager install.** The install MUST
run from the **main worktree**, never from an agent worktree under
`.claude/worktrees/` (pnpm's workspace resolution and hoisting can otherwise
link into or read from the wrong tree). Before this task is marked done, it
verifies that `readlink node_modules/husky node_modules/knip
node_modules/lint-staged node_modules/prettier node_modules/typescript` (run
from the repo root) resolves each to a real path under the main worktree's
own `node_modules/.pnpm/` store — none may point into `.claude/worktrees/` —
and a broader scan (e.g. `find node_modules -maxdepth 1 -type l -exec
readlink {} \; | grep -i worktrees`) finds nothing.
**Files:** `frontend/package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
**Done when:**
1. The post-install `pnpm-lock.yaml` diff (`git diff pnpm-lock.yaml`) adds
   only the direct `axe-core` devDependency importer entry, at exactly
   `4.11.4` — no new package entries — **other than** the peer-suffix
   normalisation on `eslint-import-resolver-typescript`,
   `eslint-module-utils`, and `eslint-plugin-import` Task 1's dry run already
   showed. If the real diff differs from that by anything beyond the named
   normalisation, this task MUST stop and report the discrepancy as blocked,
   not proceed and not hand-edit the lockfile.
2. `frontend/package.json` records `"axe-core": "4.11.4"` under
   `devDependencies`.
3. `readlink` on each of `node_modules/{husky,knip,lint-staged,prettier,
   typescript}` (repo root, main worktree) resolves outside
   `.claude/worktrees/`, and the broader `node_modules` symlink scan finds no
   entry pointing into `.claude/worktrees/`.
4. `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend lint` passes with 0 errors and
   `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend typecheck` passes.
5. A minimal smoke import (e.g. a throwaway `import { run } from
   "axe-core"` in a scratch test file, run once and then discarded, or
   confirmed via `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend exec vitest run
   --reporter=basic` against a trivial inline test) confirms the package
   resolves and imports cleanly under the repo's actual `vitest.config`
   before Task 7 depends on it.
**Depends on:** 1 (and the recorded owner approval on Task 1)
**Estimate:** 2
**Notes:** **Package-selection justification (approved set, per Task 1):**
`axe-core@4.11.4` as a direct `frontend` devDependency, specifier exactly

### Task 5: Alias the `destructive` Button variant to `secondary` (FR-1, FR-2)

**What:** Per resolved OQ-1, changes `buttonVariants`' `destructive` entry
in `frontend/components/common/UI/Button/Button.tsx` from `"border
border-gw-red-border bg-transparent text-gw-red hover:bg-gw-chrome2"` to the
exact same string as `secondary`'s: `"border border-gw-border bg-transparent
text-gw-secondary hover:border-gw-border-md hover:text-gw-primary"` — either
by aliasing (referencing the same string constant for both keys) or by
duplicating the literal string verbatim; either satisfies FR-1's "renders
identically" requirement, but aliasing (a single shared constant) is
preferred so the two variants cannot drift apart silently in a future edit.
No call site (`ConfirmDialog.tsx`, `TrashView.tsx`, the two stories files)
changes, since the variant name `destructive` is retained per FR-1.
**Files:** `frontend/components/common/UI/Button/Button.tsx`,
`frontend/tests/a11y/button.a11y.test.tsx` or a new
`frontend/tests/unit/button-destructive-variant.test.tsx` (whichever
existing test file already asserts variant class strings, confirmed by
reading it first).
**Done when:**
1. A new or updated test renders `<Button variant="destructive">` and
   `<Button variant="secondary">` and asserts their rendered `className`
   strings are identical — this test fails against the pre-fix
   `Button.tsx`, whose `destructive` string differs (red border/text).
2. A test asserts the rendered `destructive` button's class list contains
   none of `text-gw-red`, `border-gw-red-border`, or any other literal red

3. `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend exec vitest run button` passes.
4. `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend lint` passes with 0 errors.
5. `pnpm --filter getwrite-frontend typecheck` passes.
**Depends on:** none
**Estimate:** 2

**What:** Per resolved OQ-2 (amended at Gate 4), replaces the current
